task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move the top box (BOX_TOP) to a temporary location, then pick the middle box (BOX_MIDDLE) and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE, then move BOX_TOP back to the bottom box (BOX_BOTTOM) to restore the stack without the middle box.
assumptions: CAR robot starts at (0, 0) and can navigate to all locations
BOX_TOP is at (2.0, -1.0) and is currently on top of BOX_MIDDLE
BOX_MIDDLE is at (2.0, -1.0) and is supported by BOX_BOTTOM
TEMP_TABLE is at (-2.2, -1.8) and can hold BOX_TOP temporarily
interaction_distance of 2.0 is sufficient for all pick/place operations
Only top box of stack can be picked, so BOX_TOP must be moved first
